editor.premise: A snowy truck-cabin stop unfolds through arrival, fire-making, and dinner preparation, with practical routines carrying the story.

chapters.name: Arriving and settling
chapters.purpose: Establish the parked cabin, its interior, and the cold outside.

chapters.name: Lighting the stove
chapters.purpose: Turn fuel preparation into the visible reward of a warm cabin.

chapters.name: Dinner preparation
chapters.purpose: Introduce the recipe and follow cooking through successive practical steps.

captions.note: The opening graphic is centered and briefly held. Most later detected words are photographed signs, labels, and recipe handwriting, not added captions.

editor.notes: Compress repeated handling with jumps and brief dissolves, but hold ignition and developing results. Alternate working hands with wider geography. Exterior inserts let cooking time pass without showing every second or requiring spoken explanation.
